newsitem.title: GERMANY: N.Europe rapeseed buyers follow market higher.
newsitem.headline: N.Europe rapeseed buyers follow market higher.

text.p: Rapeseed buyers in northern Europe are ordering new and old crop supplies amid firmer prices, brokers said on Friday.
"Prices are holding up in line with Chicago and the strong dollar, which combine to boost soybeans," one said.
"Future direction will hinge on crop weather in Brazil and possible Canadian canola exports to Europe."
Traders were also watching the impact of a dockworkers' strike on soya shipments out of Paranagua, Brazil, where operations were hampered since Wednesday. The strike ended on Friday.
Processors were looking for rape and sunseed to complement their soybean intake because of demand-led gains in the vegetable oil and meals prices.
Old crop buyers free Hamburg were at around 487.50-490 marks a tonne, 10 marks above last week, while new crop buyers were at 465, up 17.
Statistics for July-October 1996 from the farm price office ZMP showed domestic rapeseed crushings at one million tonnes, down from 1.2 million tonnes a year earlier.
The share of domestic material was 639,000 tonnes against 858,000 tonnes a year earlier.
This was mostly due to a 30 percent loss in the 1996 rapeseed harvest, which totalled less than 2.2 million tonnes.
Brokers noted active rapeseed dealings on Matif, where May was up four marks from last night at 491 marks, up 11 on the week, and August up four from Thursday at 467, nine on the week.
Farmers in eastern Germany reported active negotiations on pre-harvest 1997 sales contracts.
Ex-farm prices in the region were around 420-430 marks and crushers were offering delivered prices of 450-460.
March rapeseed buyers at points other than Hamburg were up to 10 marks higher at 470-490, April buyers at 485-495, up 5-15, while August buyers were at 450-470, up from 440-455 last week.
March rape meal ex Hamburg mills was at 32.50-32.75 marks per 100 kg, up 0.50-1.25, April up 0.50 at 31.75 and May-first half July at 31.00, up 0.25.
German rape oil sellers quoted nearby months 2.75 marks higher than last week, with April at 93.00 marks per 100 kg, and May-July at 94.25 marks.
